rationale: The Latin anchors *extendere* and *expandere*, along with the biblical phrase *extende manum tuam* ("stretch out your hand") and *arcum suum tetendit* ("he stretched his bow"), point clearly to the sense of extending/stretching something out to its full length. The synset unfold.v.03 ("extend or stretch out to a greater or the full length") best captures this transitive, deliberate act of extending a body part or object, as attested in Mt. 12:13 (stretching out the hand) and Ps. 103:3 (spreading/stretching).
